firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently ate ice cream starts the first round. Card-flipping turns proceed clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The player with the lowest score starts subsequent rounds.
Capturing a pile can interrupt the turn sequence. The rock-paper-scissors tie-break in the rules resolves simultaneous captures of a pile, not a tie over who starts.
